# The Lantern Road

## Premise

A salt-trading caravan crosses a province where the road lamps go out one by one.

## Current Arc

The caravan has reached Harrow Ford. The toll keeper wants a ledger nobody admits to owning.

## Open Threads

- **The missing ledger** — Harrow Ford's toll keeper wants it back — since Session 2; involves the party
- **Corwin's debt to the ferrywoman** — owed for the night crossing — since Session 3; involves [[Ines_Marlowe]], [[Corwin_Hale|Corwin]]

## Key Factions

The Toll Guild keeps the bridges. The Lamplighters keep the lamps, or say they do.

## GM Notes

> [!info] Keeper Only
> The ledger lists every lamp that was paid to go dark.
